text: 澳大利亚联邦银行（CBA）经济学家贝琳达·艾伦表示，澳洲联储11月政策会议“仍存在很大悬念”。艾伦表示，CBA目前仍认为澳联储不会加息，但承认判断失误的风险较高。她指出，近期澳联储官员的表态“明显偏向鹰派”，政策重点放在通胀上行风险上，而对经济增长下行风险的关注较少。艾伦表示，澳联储近期沟通释放出的信号表明，央行仍然担忧通胀压力持续存在，并可能需要保持更加谨慎的政策立场。
text_en: Commonwealth Bank of Australia (CBA) economist Belinda Allen said the RBA's November policy meeting "still remains highly uncertain." Allen said CBA currently still believes the RBA will not raise rates, but acknowledges that the risk of misjudgment is high. She noted that recent remarks by RBA officials have been "clearly hawkish," with policy focus on upside inflation risks and less attention to downside growth risks. Allen said signals from the RBA's recent communications indicate that the central bank remains concerned about persistent inflationary pressure and may need to maintain a more cautious policy stance.
